newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-CSR expects significant profit rise.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-CSR expects significant profit rise.

text.p: CSR Ltd said on Monday that it was budgetting for a signficiant increase in full year profit.
"In percentage terms it is a very significant increase in profit we are budgetting for" chairman Alan Coates told reporters after the annual general meeting.
Asked about the first quarter result to June 30, he said the first three months had been "very much stronger".
"Whether the rate of improvement is maintained is yet to be determined," Coates said, without providing specific details.
Earlier, he told shareholders at the annual meeting that the diversified industrial and mining company expected higher profits in the current financial year ending on March 31, 1998.

The company, which has interests in building, aluminium, sugar, and timber, suffered a 36 percent fall in 1996/97 net profit to A$212.2 million. Analysts have forecast 1997/98 profits of about A$287 million.
